body.p: After . Owns src/xdm_array.c, src/xdm_function.c, tests/xdm_array_test.c, tests/xdm_function_test.c. Persistent arrays with O(log n) put, insert, remove and slice; function items (); maps and arrays answering sxml_function_item_call. Done when 10⁵ appends stay O(n log n) and captures are released with the item. Spec: XDM 4.0 §8.1, §8.4. Done 2026-10-16 (): AVL arrays of flat, run and branch nodes (split and join; 10^5 appends at most 1 + 3 x height allocations each), function items with retained captures and body state, maps and arrays as map:get and array:get.
